description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'Dish' entities within the Coocook project. It includes methods for viewing, editing, deleting, recalculating, adding ingredients, updating, repositioning ingredients, and redirecting related to dishes.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Dish
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for handling dish-related actions within the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Initializes the dish object based on the provided ID, used as a common ancestor for chained actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the dish editing page, including ingredients, tags, and related meal information.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the dish and redirects to the project edit page.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates dish ingredients based on the number of servings.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new ingredient to the dish.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Repositions an ingredient within the dish's ingredient list.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect to the dish edit page, optionally with a fragment.
